name: Google Gemini & DeepMind
description: Gemini models and app, the Gemini API and AI Studio, Gemini in Workspace and Android, and DeepMind research.

items.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash comes to Google Vids with 15-second generations
items.summary: Google brought Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash into Google Vids, where users can create clips up to 15 seconds and benefit from improved character consistency and vocal realism. The Workspace post says the rollout began November 5, with availability varying by account and edition.

items.title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash and announces automatic API routing from 1.1
items.summary: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available, adding native video generation up to 15 seconds, multi-turn editing, improved reference adherence, and 30% lower 720p pricing. The API changelog also says requests using `gemini-omni-1.1-flash` will automatically route to 1.2 at 1.2 rates beginning December 3, 2026.

items.title: Google adds Gemini-powered actionable insights to Forms responses
items.summary: Google introduced Gemini-powered insights in the Google Forms Responses tab. Gemini analyzes response data to surface trends and recommend next steps, using generated Python code for grounded counts, percentages, and comparisons; the post says the Rapid Release rollout had started November 2, while Scheduled Release rollout is set to start November 19.

items.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech launch AntiScam Pango beta
items.summary: Singapore’s GovTech launched the AntiScam Pango Android beta in collaboration with Google DeepMind, following their work on an on-device scam-detection model. The app flags suspicious messages while keeping private conversations on the user’s device, applying the research in a public-facing tool.

items.title: Google introduces new Gemini capabilities for its Agentic Data Cloud
items.summary: Google announced that Gemini can work directly on its borderless Lakehouse, allowing business users to query records across clouds using natural language. The post also describes Gemini agents that can generate and troubleshoot data-engineering workflows and create operational reports, extending Gemini’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities.

items.title: DeepMind adds cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity, demonstrating an agent-assisted drug-discovery workflow involving compound searches, molecular analysis, potency modeling, and proposed macrocycles with synthesis routes. The post says the workflow can accelerate work that previously took multiple days, but stresses that computational designs remain hypotheses requiring experimental validation.

items.title: Google reports research findings on Guided Learning and student outcomes
items.summary: Google reported two studies of Guided Learning in student and classroom settings. In a randomized trial with more than 300 University of Tokyo students, those with Guided Learning improved test scores by 8.1 percentage points versus 5.3 points for students using standard web tools, which Google described as 1.5× higher learning gains in one study session.

items.title: Google brings Guided Learning to Classroom and Search and updates K-12 AI controls
items.summary: Google made Guided Learning globally available in Google Classroom and said it is bringing Guided Learning capabilities to Search, beginning with a pilot in select U.S. schools later in November. Google also plans to make Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Search unavailable by default for K-12 student accounts until a school administrator turns them on.

items.title: Google deprecates Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash, schedules API routing changes
items.summary: Google deprecated Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash in the Gemini API and removed them from the AI Studio model picker. Starting December 1, 2026, requests to those model IDs will route to Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, respectively.

items.title: Google DeepMind expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to 12 more councils
items.summary: Google DeepMind is expanding its Gemini-powered PlanAssist tool to 12 additional local planning authorities in England, bringing the total involved to 15 for a 12-month beta using live applications. Early pilots reported a 58% reduction in time spent on householder application assessments, while qualified planning officers retain final approval.

items.title: Google showcases Gemini 4 Argon agents building a dancing robot from a prompt
items.summary: Google highlighted a Google DeepMind robotics project in which AI agents powered by Gemini 4 Argon and Antigravity helped create a physical, dancing 12-degree-of-freedom robot from a plain-English prompt. The demonstration is a notable example of Gemini-powered agents being used in a real-world robotics workflow without manual CAD.

items.title: Gemini adds in-chat document creation, preview, and editing
items.summary: Gemini now lets users create, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and other files within a chat. Google says PDF preview and editing are available on web and mobile, while other listed formats are currently web-only; the capabilities are available to all Gemini app users in supported regions and languages.

items.title: Google reports Gemini classroom-study findings from the UK and Italy
items.summary: Google shared findings from studies in the UK and Italy on Gemini’s use in classrooms. The UK trial found AI tutoring provided math support comparable to human tutors for many students; the Italy study reported higher participation and more student-led collaboration when teachers used Gemini to co-design lessons.

items.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 enters public preview on Google Cloud
items.summary: Google made Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 available in public preview through Model Garden in the Gemini platform on Google Cloud. The model is designed to support robotics with spatial and temporal video understanding, long-horizon planning, and safety guardrails, bringing the research model into an enterprise cloud environment.

items.title: Google showcases eight examples of Gemini 4 Argon in action
items.summary: Google published eight demonstrations of Gemini 4 Argon, spanning deep research, complex tasks, interactive tools, and 3D design. The post highlights the model's reasoning, coding, and multimodal workflow capabilities, providing concrete examples of how Google says Argon can be used.

items.title: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4, a new world-simulation model
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a multimodal world model for realistic, real-time interactive simulation that can generate environmental sounds and dialogue alongside the world. It is currently a research preview for trusted testers, with access planned for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early-access partners through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini API CLI for agents
items.summary: Google DeepMind team member Philipp Schmid announced the Gemini API CLI, a stateless command-line tool that lets developers call Gemini API capabilities from agents they already use. The post lists media generation, file and media analysis, transcription, and background Deep Research among its tasks.

items.title: Google DeepMind and Springer Nature partner to develop an AI peer-review assistant
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Springer Nature announced a research partnership to co-design an AI assistant for peer reviewers. The prototype is intended to help researchers navigate manuscripts and analyze text, charts, and figures while keeping expert human judgment central.

items.title: Google DeepMind releases a global map of forest types
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research, working with the World Resources Institute and IIASA, released Forest Typology 2020, a global 10-meter-resolution map distinguishing six forest and land-use types. They also shared an early time series tracking changes from 2017 to 2025, including natural forests converted to plantations or farms.
